policy.regeneration: Required when enabled mods, their contents, the game version or load order change. This is a load-time adapter, not a runtime universal override.
policy.personalIncome: No salary, domicile or income-source modifier is changed; final engine taxable-income exclusions require in-game validation.

precedence: Apply replace_path and same-virtual-file overlays in enabled_mods order; parse remaining virtual paths in lexical order; the last named definition wins.
